settings.intro: RunecraftHelper: while the in-game Runeshape Combinations panel is open, the poe.ninja Exalted price is drawn on the right edge of each visible reward row. The reward name shown is the game's own (any client language).
settings.league_hint: Prices are fetched for exactly this poe.ninja league.
settings.custom_league_hint:
Enter poe.ninja's API name, with spaces ("Runes of Aldur") — not the web slug
("runesofaldur"), which the API answers with an empty result.
settings.league_adopted: League "{0}" is gone from poe.ninja; switched to "{1}".
status.label: Status: {0}
status.zero_rows:
poe.ninja answered, but has no rows for this league. Check the league name: it must be
the API name with spaces ("Runes of Aldur"), not the web slug ("runesofaldur").
mono.glow_hint:
Labels a monolith on the large map with the rune(s) it would propagate from its gold
socket, best first, joined by " | ". Only runes the rune-chain table values above
1.00 are shown — a monolith with nothing worth propagating stays unlabelled.
mono.highlight_threshold_hint:
Tints a monolith's header by its best reward value: green at/above the
threshold, yellow from 0.6× up to it, none below. 0 = off (use Price color).
mono.map_value_hint: Paints each monolith's best value (ex) on the large-map overlay
exp.planner_hint: A planner window appears while the in-game explosive HUD is visible
exp.spine_hint:
Large map (Tab): draws the Router's strict-spine polyline (cyan) — the path
walked (detonator → anchors), shown separately from the charge placements.
exp.log_hint:
Writes a full decision trace on each Run (every candidate, its score,
rejections, gate openings, final pick) to expedition_planner_log.txt in the
plugin folder. For debugging why the route chose a path.
exp.run_tip_stale: Settings changed — click to (re)build the route.
exp.manual_hint: Controller + HUD unreadable — set total to match the in-game counter, then Run.
exp.last_plan: last plan: {0:F0} ms · A* {1} run = {2:F0} ms · {3} cached
exp.map_mods_hint: auto-detected from the map's Expedition modifiers
exp.eff_values: → distance {0:F0} grid · radius {1:F0} grid · {2} base  (auto each map)
exp.monolith_min_hint: Monoliths with best reward ≥ this are routed.
exp.weight_profiles_hint: Weight profiles (create / edit the tables in Settings → Show route planner):
exp.min_markers_hint:
After monoliths, a spare charge is used only if it covers this many
markers at once (normal maps; Grand routes every weighted target).
prof.reward_hint:
Weight each reward marker (0 = ignore, blank types default to 1). Monoliths are
valued by their real reward price — this profile only weights the markers.
prof.buff_hint:
Weight each relic mod (a plain weight, not ex). A relic becomes a route target when its
Σ(+ weights) − Σ(− weights) is > 0; otherwise it's ignored. Both columns take positive
numbers — the − column is an avoidance penalty. Stored by internal mod id (any language).
runechain.enable_hint:
The gold-framed socket marks the rune that propagates to every pack unearthed LATER in
the chain, and buffing those monsters raises their drops. In the panel the GREEN frame
keeps meaning "most valuable reward"; an AMBER frame around a rune name marks the
strongest rune this monolith can propagate. Two separate calls, not one merged number.
runechain.base_ex_hint:
Expected drop value of ONE pack of Runic monsters. The chain value scales linearly with
this, so it is the main calibration knob — measure it, don't trust the default.
runechain.affects_route: Let the chain value steer the route
runechain.affects_route_hint:
Adds each monolith's best achievable chain value to its route weight. This is an UPPER
BOUND — the real value depends on how many packs come after that monolith, which is
only known once the order is fixed. Off keeps the router exactly as it is today.
runechain.table_hint:
Loot multiplier per propagated rune. 1.00 = no loot effect (pure danger). Below 1.00 = a
net cost (Oath seeds immortal loot-less waves; Wisdom only grants experience). Magnitudes
are server-side, so these are estimates ordered by the community tier list.
runechain.power_factor_hint:
A propagated Power rune empowers the other runes in the chain (official 0.5.4 fix). Whether
Power is live is READ per monolith from the station (the same flag the game uses to draw the
empowered rune art), so this only says by how much it multiplies their uplift.
